components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is used to compose the read-only salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the structured address fields are supplied they take precedence and this is returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) the structured fields take precedence over the flat 'address' and are normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like addressLine1 and, when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be a 4-digit code valid for the city's canonical region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it is stored and used to derive the read-only ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode), bypassing the household duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space and the last name when a title was supplied, or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

## Owner deletion → soft-delete

**What the endpoint now does:** `DELETE /api/owners/{id}` marks the owner deleted and keeps the row (returns 204, which is 2xx); `GET /api/owners/{id}` still returns the owner afterward with `deleted: true`; a freshly created owner reads back `deleted: false`; and the create-time duplicate/identity checks skip any owner flagged deleted, so a would-be blocking duplicate is allowed once the only match has been soft-deleted.

**Changes made:**

- **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `Boolean deleted` field (`@Column(name="deleted")`, defaulting to `FALSE`) with getter/setter, so new owners start not-deleted and MapStruct maps it by name.
- **`rest/function/owner/DeleteOwner.java`** — instead of `repository.delete(owner)`, it now sets `deleted = true` and `save`s, keeping the DELETE pipeline (load → delete → respond-204) and its transaction governance intact.
- **`rest/function/owner/CheckUniqueOwnerIdentity.java`** — the blocking exact/household duplicate check now `continue`s past any owner with `deleted == true`.
- **`rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java`** — the soft possible-duplicate match likewise ignores deleted owners (consistency with the identity check).
- **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it in responses.
- **DB schemas** (`db/hsqldb`, `db/h2`, `db/mysql`, `db/postgres`) — added a `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` column to the `owners` table. The tests run on hsqldb (`ddl-auto=none`), so its schema change is what the suite exercises; the others were kept in step.

Tests: `AcceptanceTest` (`coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains`, `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck`) and the rest of the suite pass — `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, `BUILD SUCCESS`.
